notes.title: On The Brink | Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everybody! [/h1]
First of all, thank you for playing! It means the world to us that even just one person has taken a chance on our game. Second, [b]we've heard you![/b] The lack of tutorials made it very frustrating to know how to move around. We're fixing that in this patch, along with a couple of other bugs!

[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced speed lost from taking damage
[/list]
[h3]Capricorn[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enlarged tutorial rings for easier orbiting
[*] Added right-ward movement explanation
[*] Added constellation drawing explanation
[*] Added controls for constellation drawing
[/list]
[h3]Taurus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added dash aiming tutorial text
[*] Added goal explanation text
[/list]
[h3]Aquarius[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the final cutscene would not play (Windows Only)
[/list]

[h2]Thanks for bearing with us,[/h2]
and thanks even more for your feedback! We hope this takes away some of the confusion players have been experiencing. Please keep it coming and enjoy playing [i]On The Brink![/i]
